info.title: Darwin API
info.description: Search executable capabilities, manage durable work through explicit Action operations, and administer developer credentials for the signed-in account.

post.description: Find and rank public capabilities from the active Creora Product v2 index. Search is discovery, not execution authorization. No credential is required at the public anonymous limit. You may supply a Darwin API key or OAuth bearer with directory:read for the higher authenticated limit.

200.description: A page of public capabilities in canonical order.

429.description: The current anonymous or authenticated Search allowance has been reached.

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before trying Search again.

RateLimit-Limit.description: Maximum Search requests allowed in the current 60-second window.

RateLimit-Remaining.description: Search requests remaining in the current window.

RateLimit-Reset.description: Seconds until the current Search window resets.

post.description: Register an unverified Darwin account without creating an AI or API key. Verify the email address through Darwin sign-in, then complete account setup before issuing application credentials. An application key never identifies an end user.

get.description: Read the account behind a user-bound legacy key or a user-scoped OAuth grant with account:read. Application-only keys cannot read or impersonate an account.

parameters.name: aiId
parameters.description: Optional authorized AI context to select in the response; omit to use the active selection.

post.description: Register a developer application for the authenticated account. Requires applications:write on a user-scoped OAuth grant or a legacy user key. This does not grant access to another user.

get.description: Read one application owned by the authenticated account. Requires applications:read on a user-scoped grant or legacy key.

post.description: Start durable work from an exact Search result. A consenting human OAuth user uses human:actions without an AI; an AI-scoped caller uses agent:write or goals:write and selects an authorized acting AI.

200.description: The current truthful state of the action.

get.description: List current or ended human Actions with human:actions, or select an acting AI for an AI-scoped agent:read/goals:read grant.

200.description: A page of the caller’s current actions.

actions.title: Book the selected stay
actions.intent: Reserve the exact stay selected from Search.

get.description: Get the truthful current status and required next step for one action. Requires the matching human:actions grant or an AI-scoped agent:read/goals:read grant.

parameters.name: actionId
parameters.description: The Action identifier returned by Start action or List actions.

200.description: The current truthful state of the action.

patch.description: Give an action more information without implicitly approving anything. Requires the matching human:actions or AI-scoped agent:write/goals:write grant.

parameters.name: actionId
parameters.description: The Action identifier returned by Start action or List actions.

200.description: The current truthful state of the action.

post.description: Establish or reuse one bounded authentication relationship between the caller and a destination AI. When the destination has no account for the user, the same hosted flow completes required first-time setup before connecting. The relationship can be reused across Actions until it expires or is revoked.

parameters.name: aiId
parameters.description: The destination AI to authenticate with.

200.description: The reusable authentication relationship or a first-party webLink for the required provider step.

post.description: Choose a bound direct or Darwin Pay route without overriding the reviewed merchant, amount, currency, protocol, or scope.

parameters.name: actionId
parameters.description: The Action identifier returned by Start action or List actions.

200.description: The current truthful state of the action.

example.actionRequired: Complete the bound payment in Darwin.
Complete the bound payment in Darwin.

post.description: Apply an exact reviewed approval decision with stale-preview protection. Requires the matching human:actions or AI-scoped agent:write/goals:write grant.

parameters.name: actionId
parameters.description: The Action identifier returned by Start action or List actions.

200.description: The current truthful state of the action.

post.description: Compatibility operation that interrupts only the current queued or running turn. New integrations should use End action for one clear finish-or-cancel closure flow. Requires the matching human:actions or AI-scoped agent:write/goals:write grant.

parameters.name: actionId
parameters.description: The Action identifier returned by Start action or List actions.

200.description: The current truthful state of the action.

post.description: Freeze ordinary new work and request durable closure with finish or cancel intent. Darwin derives the final outcome; the caller cannot declare success.

parameters.name: actionId
parameters.description: The Action identifier returned by Start action or List actions.

200.description: The current truthful state of the action.

post.description: Create an application-only key for an owned application. It can Search public capabilities but cannot impersonate a user or Act. The plaintext apiKey is returned once. Requires a verified account session.

201.description: The API key was created. Store apiKey securely because Darwin will not return it again.

get.description: List application keys and existing legacy user-bound keys for the signed-in account. Plaintext secrets are never included.

200.description: Every API key owned by the account, including expired and revoked keys.

get.description: Get lifetime authenticated-request counts for the account and each API key. This is operational key usage, not billable Action spend. Requires an authenticated account session.

200.description: Lifetime API-key request counts and key-status totals.

delete.description: Revoke an API key owned by the signed-in Darwin account. Revocation is immediate and keeps non-secret audit metadata. Requires an authenticated account session.

parameters.name: apiKeyId
parameters.description: The API-key ID returned by Create API key or List API keys. This is not the secret key value.

get.description: List Search-history entries retained for up to 90 days for a user-bound legacy key or user-scoped OAuth grant. Application-only keys cannot read a user’s history.

200.description: A bounded page of retained Search-history entries.

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Pass your Darwin API key in the x-api-key header. You can also authenticate with Authorization: Bearer <apiKey>.

bearer.bearerFormat: Darwin API key or OAuth access token
bearer.description: Pass a Darwin API key or OAuth access token as Authorization: Bearer <token>. You can also pass a Darwin API key in x-api-key.

AccountSession.name: __Secure-better-auth.session_token
AccountSession.description: The HTTP-only Darwin account session cookie set after sign-in. Local development uses better-auth.session_token without the __Secure- prefix.

organizationDomain.description: Required for business and software; not ownership proof.

id.description: Stable non-secret identifier for the API key.

name.description: Human-readable key name supplied at creation.

prefix.description: Non-secret prefix you can use to identify the key in logs and settings.

scopes.description: Permissions granted to the key. Every API operation still enforces its required scope.

requestCount.description: Lifetime number of requests authenticated with this key.

lastUsedAt.description: When Darwin most recently authenticated a request with this key, or null if unused.

expiresAt.description: When the key expires, or null when it has no scheduled expiration.

revokedAt.description: When the key was revoked, or null while it has not been revoked.

kind.description: New keys identify an application; legacy keys retain their previous user-bound behavior until revoked.

applicationId.description: The application identified by a new key, or null for a legacy user key.

apiKey.description: Plaintext API key. Darwin returns this value only in the create response.

applicationId.description: An active application owned by the signed-in account.

name.description: A recognizable name for the environment or integration that will use this key.

scopes.description: Optional. New application keys are limited to directory:read; use OAuth for user-scoped Act.

expiresAt.description: Optional future ISO 8601 expiration. Omit or set null for no scheduled expiration.

query.description: Describe the capability or outcome you need in natural language. Include the task, important constraints, and success criteria that should affect ranking; use the dedicated AI and capability read endpoints for exact lookups.
query.example: Find an AI that can compare SOC 2 vendors and return a cited recommendation under $500.

filters.description: Optional structured constraints applied in addition to the natural-language query. Use these fields for hard requirements instead of embedding machine-readable filters in query text.

limit.description: Maximum number of ranked capabilities to return. Defaults to 10 and cannot exceed 50.

capabilityTypes.description: Return only these public capability types. PRODUCT is a purchasable item, SERVICE is delivered work, CAPABILITY is an executable ability, CAPACITY is available throughput, ASSET is a licensable resource, DATA is a dataset, and RIGHT is a permission or entitlement.

executionDomains.description: Return only capabilities delivered in these execution domains: HUMAN for people-led work, DIGITAL for software or online work, and PHYSICAL for work involving real-world goods or locations.

capabilityKinds.description: Return only these executable capability kinds. Use this when the integration mechanism is a hard requirement; leave it unset when Darwin should rank across mechanisms.

protocols.description: Require every returned capability to support each listed public protocol. Multiple values use AND semantics, not OR semantics.

maxPriceMinor.description: Maximum acceptable advertised starting price in the smallest unit of the requested currency, such as cents for USD.

currency.description: Require structured pricing in this uppercase ISO 4217 currency.

requiresExecutableRoute.description: When true, require an observed executable route in the active index. This does not grant the caller permission to start an Act action.

ActStartRequest.title: Start action
ActStartRequest.description: Start durable work from an exact Search capability and revision.

ActUpdateRequest.title: Continue action
ActUpdateRequest.description: Give an action more information, submit bounded completion feedback, or report a safety issue. No variant implicitly approves anything.

ActPayRequest.title: Pay for action
ActPayRequest.description: Choose how to complete the exact payment interaction. Merchant, amount, currency, protocol, and scope remain server-bound.

save.description: Explicit consent to save a tokenized processor reference after a successful one-time flow.

AuthenticateSessionRequest.title: Authenticate session
AuthenticateSessionRequest.description: Create or reuse one authentication relationship between the calling AI and the destination AI. The same hosted flow completes required first-time provider setup before authorization. The selected method and scopes come from the destination AI metadata, not an individual Action.

saveToDarwinVault.description: Explicit consent to persist a one-time credential in Darwin Vault after authorization.

ActEndRequest.title: End action
ActEndRequest.description: Request durable closure. Finish may create a required verification interaction; cancel stops new work and requests cancellation of cancelable activity. Darwin, not the caller, derives outcome.

AuthenticateSessionResponse.title: Authentication session
AuthenticateSessionResponse.description: A reusable, revocable relationship between the calling AI and one destination AI. A pending response includes one first-party webLink for any required account setup, sign-in, and authorization; a connected response includes a durable connection identifier.

ActApproveRequest.title: Approve action
ActApproveRequest.description: Apply an exact reviewed approval decision with stale-preview protection.

ActStopRequest.title: Stop action
ActStopRequest.description: Stop the current queued or running turn without claiming the entire transaction was canceled.

AuthenticationInteraction.title: Authentication
AuthenticationInteraction.description: A provider and scope requirement bound to the Action. The same hosted flow completes first-time provider setup when needed. A completed saved grant becomes a revocable connection record; authentication never grants payment or approval authority.

kind.description: `connection` is a deprecated compatibility alias until the runtime migration ships.

ApprovalInteraction.title: Approval
ApprovalInteraction.description: An exact reviewed consequential decision. The approval ID, payload digest, revision, and expiry must all still match when the user decides.

VerificationInteraction.title: Verification
VerificationInteraction.description: A verifier-owned claim and success policy bound to the selected capability revision. The caller can choose only one advertised method and cannot supply the verdict.

ActionOutcome.title: Content-free Action outcome
ActionOutcome.description: A bounded terminal classification. Unknown and censored outcomes are never silently relabeled as failures.

defaultMode.description: Null means Darwin asks before the first message to each AI.
